reviews.title: Great Coffee Grinder for Fresh Coffee Every Day
reviews.body: I'm very happy with this coffee grinder. It's easy to use, quiet, and offers many grind size settings, making it perfect for different brewing methods. The coffee comes out evenly ground, and the large bean hopper is very convenient. It feels well-made and works exactly as expected. I highly recommend it to anyone who enjoys fresh coffee at home.

reviews.title: Excellent Coffee Grinder
reviews.body: After a bit more than a week of using this coffee grinder, I am very pleased. It is quiet, and it grinds very evenly. The anti-static feature is great, becuase it keeps the ground coffee from sticking inside the output cup.The “cup” selector is a bit off. I brew my coffee using the “pour-over” method with a Chemex pot. If I grind enough for what this grinder identifies for 3 cups, I get sufficient coffee for about 8 cups—but it is consistently that amount, so experiment to find the amount of ground coffee you need for your method of preparation.

reviews.title: Difficult to assemble
reviews.body: I did not care for this burr grinder at all. It was difficult to attach the bean dispenser and then when it was attached, it would become unattached while trying to dial in the desired grind. I messed around for about an hour before I called it quits and put it back in the box to start my return.The one positive thing was the quiet way it did operate. I will definitely be shopping for a quiet machine.

reviews.title: GGgood grinds
reviews.body: Compared with my earlier coffee mill that was not a conical burr, the size is consistent. It’s also a bit slower and doesn’t heat the beans during the grinding. My other unit imparted a burnt taste. Not an issue with this unit.I consider this a good value, especially in light of how much some high end units cost.I have not had it long enough to rate the durability.
